name: Mother And Son
overview: Scripture highlights the profound bond between mother and son, emphasizing the importance of a mother's instruction and care in shaping a son's life, as seen in Proverbs 1:8 and 22:6. The tender compassion of a mother is likened to God's unfailing remembrance and love for His people in Isaiah 49:15. The joy that follows a mother's labor, described in John 16:21, parallels the redemptive joy brought through Christ, who, even on the cross, entrusts His mother to the beloved disciple, illustrating the enduring responsibilities within family relationships (John 19:26). Ultimately, every good gift, including the gift of family, comes from God, the unchanging Father of lights (James 1:17).
